The Nest Theatre – Columbus Comedy Festival Skip to content Skip to footer facebook-1 video-light instagram youtube email-1 The Nest Theatre The Nest Theatre began in the fall of 2016. After a few location bounces, The Nest is in its new home at 2643 N High St. This location was actually the first space that the owners looked at! It is right in between Hounddog’s Pizza and Ace of Cups making it a perfect clubhouse for improvisers and audiences, both centrally located and suburban fans alike. The Nest houses 40+ rotaional shows! Chicago-style longform improv, shortform improv (think Whose Line and Wild ‘n Out), scripted sketch comedy shows (popularized by the Second City of Toronto & Chicago), as well as world-famous improvised musical duo, HERE the Musical. And that is just the tip of the iceberg! Comedy Festival Shows Taking Place at The Nest Theatre: Thursday August 27th – 7:30pm – Improv + Standups: Pad Set! Friday August 28th – 7:30pm – Improv + Standups: Pad Set! Friday August 28th – 9:30pm – Armando CBus Saturday August 29th – 7:30pm – Connor Ratliff’s The Acting Class Saturday August 29th – 9:00pm – Improv + Standups: Pad Set! The Nest Theatre is located at 2643 North High Street, Columbus, OH 43215. Stand-Up & Improv Showcase @ Nest Sep 4, 2025 @ 8:30 pm $15 CLICK HERE FOR TICKETS Stand Up: Chad the Bird Allison McBane Tyson Colson Improv: Armando CBUS The Nest Theatre + Comedy Arts Center is proud to present their guests for Columbus Comedy Festival 2025! This space celebrates features and headlining comics and one of our most popular improvisational shows, with standups as the guests! Come enjoy standup from beloved local comics Allison McBane and Tyson Colson, along with headliner Chad the Bird.
